name: speaker
description: Speaker ON/OFF reference captures for X3's defect-3 verification. Reference semantics (DefineButton2_90 on(release): vol 0<->1, stopAllSounds, SharedObject 'data'.vol persisted; DefineSprite_88 frames on/off with the raw CXFORM in tags.xml; frame_2 boot restores vol from the SharedObject). The sprite's frame check runs when its frames are entered, so the OFF visual is rendered at boot with a persisted vol=0 — the scenario reaches it through the reference's own persistence path: click (vol=0) -> flush wait -> reload -> capture speaker-off; then click (vol=1) -> reload -> capture speaker-on for symmetry.
